shared_existing_foundation.reuse: schema-qualified PostgreSQL function call extraction, OID/signature resolution, incoming/outgoing consumer relations
shared_existing_foundation.scope_qualification: M0.3 frozen seed, hash, 109/118/262/33/21 historic counts are not valid generic query acceptance on PE10
shared_existing_foundation.inputs: Only frozen P0 event ID and authorized current readbacks; P0 labels and CURRENT labels remain distinct

shared_obligations.rule: Start from actual P0 caller identities and ALL declared callee names; do not treat inventory as closed-world current consumer universe

Scan all authorized pg_proc user schemas for direct incoming references to discovered candidates, including functions beyond initial lexical namespace; classify remote/Edge/dynamic consumers as UNKNOWN unless actual source inspected
Identify callers by exact schema+name+identity args (or OID), preserve called schema when explicit; unresolved overloads and unqualified ambiguities cannot become verified edges

Use lexical call tokens as STATIC_CALL_CANDIDATE only; inspect concrete body contexts and negatives for comments, string/dynamic SQL and prefix/suffix collisions before promoting an individual static edge
Partition every edge into HISTORICAL_EDGE_DECLARED, CURRENT_EDGE_NOT_IN_P0 or CURRENT_CONSUMER_OUTSIDE_P0; historical comparison does not establish runtime execution

When concrete material edges appear in individual role RAW, synthesizer must preserve each edge with source identity/query ID or give an explicit evidence-based exclusion reason; summary counts cannot replace identities

Positive and negative tests must include full-universe/selector differences, prefix false continuity, overloaded/multi-schema ambiguity, missing callee objects, comment-only and dynamic SQL unknown, plus assertion that CURRENT is not P0

No READY/DONE/REPAIR claim from a mere lexical reference. Record attempted sources, unresolved reachable paths, false positives, query/material costs and stop only on evidence closure or real authority barrier
Source and evaluator separation: initial producer input must exclude this C1 evaluator-only audit, original other-arm RAW, hidden rubric and all previous expected-answer summaries

specialist_responsibility.ARCHITECTURE: Reconstruct exact caller/callee typed graph in both directions; include schema/oid/overloads/lifecycle and compare historical vs current
specialist_responsibility.COVERAGE: Prove selector complement and full material consumer set or mark unknown; test missing/external and namespace candidates
specialist_responsibility.INNOVATION: Generate and falsify alternative causal accounts, especially false continuity and nominal-only dependency claims
specialist_responsibility.PERFORMANCE: Quantify graph-query costs only when measured and do not infer performance from static source
specialist_responsibility.AUTHORITY: Separate P0 authority from current readbacks; check permissions and source provenance
specialist_responsibility.SYNTHESIZER: Preserve material edge witness ledger, contradictions and unknowns from all frozen specialist results

generic_delta: Adversarial GDE hypothesis ranking must incorporate discovered incoming references and omitted/unresolved edges as conflict hypotheses
Freeze five role-bound reports BEFORE synthesis
No silent loss of material identified edges in synthesis
Validate partitions over complete typed incoming/outgoing graph, not only manually preselected rows
A reconciled TLP total is necessary but never sufficient for completeness of consumer discovery
Typed evidence-governed decision must cite individual consumer witnesses or unknown scope, not counts alone

producer_source_allowlist: original P0 frozen context as supplied to PE10_M18/PE10_M29
assigned PE10 M18 E2 or M29 E2 contract
generic M0.3-derived read-only helper and validator
current authorized schema/source readbacks only when qualified as CURRENT
proof_requirements: immutable original RAW and judge input timestamps
independent evaluator after two evolved RAW freezes

evaluation_policy: C3 uses the EXACT same frozen P0; deterministic method-unit tests are NOT benchmark cases and cannot count as autonomous discovery of hidden findings.
